tagline: Regional bank generating income primarily from net interest on loans and securities
hero_kpi_rationale: As a regional bank, net interest income represents the primary source of revenue and key driver of profitability. It is the fundamental KPI for evaluating the performance of a banking institution.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income on loans and securities and interest expense on deposits and borrowings
kpis.description: Principal source of revenue for banks, representing net return on interest-earning assets

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Net interest income divided by average interest-earning assets, measuring profitability of asset deployment
kpis.description: Key indicator of banking profitability and efficiency in managing interest rate spreads

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last four reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last four fiscal years.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last four fiscal years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance for the last four fiscal years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance for the last four fiscal years.

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance for the last four fiscal years.

risks.title: Credit Risk and Loan Loss Provisions
risks.score_rationale: Central to the business model, discussed extensively in Risk Factors. Net interest income depends on loan quality. Allowance for Credit Losses is a critical accounting estimate. Language emphasizes material adverse effects. Risk directly tied to core banking operations.

risks.title: Pending Merger with Prosperity Bancshares
risks.score_rationale: Merger Agreement dated January 27, 2026 with multiple regulatory conditions (Federal Reserve, FDIC, Texas Department of Banking) and shareholder approvals required. Existential transformation event with significant execution risk. New major development.

risks.title: Interest Rate Sensitivity and Net Interest Margin Compression
risks.score_rationale: MD&A explicitly states principal market risk is interest rate exposure. Net interest margin depends on rate spreads. Fed policy directly impacts yield curves and deposit costs. Recurring structural risk documented across Item 1 (Business) and Item 7 (MD&A).

risks.title: Critical Accounting Estimates on Loan Loss Allowances
risks.score_rationale: Allowance for Credit Losses identified as most critical accounting estimate requiring significant judgment. Subjective models and macroeconomic assumptions create estimation risk. Errors could require material provision adjustments.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill subject to annual impairment testing. Macroeconomic and sector-specific factors can trigger impairment charges. Particularly relevant given pending merger transaction which may create triggering events.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration Risk to Texas Economy
risks.score_rationale: Loan portfolio heavily concentrated in Texas, particularly energy, real estate, and technology sectors. Economic performance and competitive conditions in Texas are primary drivers of asset quality. Vulnerability to regional economic cycles and commodity price volatility.

risks.title: Regulatory Approval Dependency for Merger Completion
risks.score_rationale: Merger requires approvals from Federal Reserve, FDIC, and Texas Department of Banking. Failed regulatory approval would terminate transaction and leave company independent but with integration planning costs. Uncertainty around timeline and conditions.

ai_positioning.summary: The company STEL does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
